sections.description:
Short title and commencement

THE OPIUM (EXTENSION TO THE PUNJAB) ACT, 1951
THE OPIUM
(EXTENSION TO THE PUNJAB) ACT, 1951.
ACT No. XII of 1951
(For Statement of Objects and Reasons, see Gaz. of P.,1951,
Pt. V, p.80)
[28th April,
1951]
An Act to extend the Opium Act, 1857, to the Punjab
1. Short title and
commencement.----‑(1) This Act may be called the Opium (Extension to
the Punjab) Act, 1951.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
